record.headerIcon: Outlined checked document in both sizes and both themes
record.grouping: Separate bordered day panels or rows; tinted today background
adaptiveLayouts: one-row: side-by-side dates and horizontal stages; compact date/stage strip for very short landscape hosts
wide/short: side-by-side days with horizontal stages
wide/tall: side-by-side days with vertical stage rows
narrow/short: shared stage headings and compact day rows
narrow/tall: stacked day cards with three icon columns

appointments.grouping: Distinct date, appointment, and treatment regions
appointments.layout: Measure actual font metrics and launcher space; choose one or two care columns, compact gaps before reducing text; split department/care panels on short wide hosts. On tall hosts, allow up to 0.75dp less text size to avoid broken care names.
appointments.overflow: Preserve all selected and legacy care items without scrolling or ellipsis. Long lists use smaller text; increasing the widget size improves readability.

implementationNotes: Light and dark share data and layout; change colors only.
Use launcher-provided dimensions; records can shrink to one grid row while appointments default to two.
